338603.title: Conjecture on chromatic core subgraphs of strong graph products
338603.literal_statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs, and let $G'$ and $H'$ be chromatic core subgraphs of $G$ and $H$, respectively. The **strong product** $G\boxtimes H$ has vertex set $V(G)\times V(H)$, with adjacency given by adjacency in either factor while the other coordinate is equal, or adjacency in both factors. **Strong-product chromatic-core conjecture.** The strong product $G'\boxtimes H'$ is a chromatic core subgraph of $G\boxtimes H$. This conjecture is motivated in the source by standard bounds on the chromatic number of the strong product and by its relation to the tensor and Cartesian products. No resolution is supplied, so its status is open.

338604.title: Conjecture on chromatic core subgraphs of general graph products
338604.literal_statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs with chromatic core subgraphs $G'$ and $H'$, respectively, and let $G\circledast H$ denote the general graph product used in the source. **General-product chromatic-core conjecture.** The graph $G'\circledast H'$ is a chromatic core subgraph of $G\circledast H$. The source does not specify a standard definition of the operation $\circledast$ or provide resolution evidence, so the conjecture remains open here.
